story: Early breakaway of six riders included Miguel Heidemann, who secured the KOM title. UAE team controlled the peloton, catching the break with 15 km to go. Attacks by Barré, del Toro, and Vacek followed. Del Toro led solo on the Jägerhaus climb but was caught near the finish. Paul Magnier won the sprint, with del Toro securing overall victory.
